Senses.Explanation: Chuanzi asks Jiashan why he does not speak when the fishing line hangs a thousand feet and the intention lies in the deep pool; later hall sermons reuse the same long-line and deep-water pair. The complete cases preserve fishing actions around the couplet: hanging line, hook, deep water, hooked fish, and Jiashan being pressed to speak.
